title: Implement negotiated MCP and CLI client transports
body:
## Summary

Implements the consolidated S9a-S9d client-transport phase from the accepted Wayfinder plan. This adds fail-closed HTTP contract negotiation, bounded and principal-owned MCP transport sessions, explicit versioned MCP evidence tools, and negotiated CLI rendering while keeping HTTP as the production execution authority.

Closes #99

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [x] New feature
- [x] Refactor / cleanup
- [ ] Docs only
- [x] Build / CI / tooling

## Changes

- Adds GET-only capability negotiation with a 60-second, origin/deployment-scoped bounded cache and no speculative or fallback execution POST.
- Secures streamable HTTP and legacy SSE with bearer/Host/Origin/CORS/body guards; binds random process-local sessions to principals; enforces 256-session capacity and 30-minute exact idle expiry.
- Pins the audited MCP SDK to `1.27.0`, validates one packaged immutable release descriptor independently in HTTP and MCP startup, and refuses drift fail-closed.
- Preserves frozen v1 MCP wire contracts and adds `search_web_v2`, `recover_url_v2`, `expand_links_v2`, and `extract_content_v2` with exact structured envelopes and an 11 MiB streamed response bound.
- Shares strict v2 envelope/status validation across MCP and CLI, including accepted partial evidence on failure.
- Makes configured-authority CLI retrieval authenticated HTTP-only while preserving Tier-1/no-server behavior through explicit standalone modules and gates.
- Strengthens architecture tests so production MCP/CLI modules cannot regain broker, extraction, readiness, cache, or persistence authority.

## Testing

- [x] `ARGUS_AUTOLOAD_DOTENV=false ARGUS_EGRESS_TYPE=datacenter ARGUS_RESIDENTIAL_POLICY=fallback uv run pytest -q` — `2098 passed, 43 skipped, 4 pre-existing warnings`
- [x] Changed-file `ruff check` and `ruff format --check`
- [x] `uv lock --check`
- [x] Frozen v1/private-field/rejected-value sentinels — `3 passed`
- [x] `git diff --check a4df7d25618674d976a29c3f0865c5f7bca5bf19..03e339c`
- [x] Clean committed-wheel descriptor member SHA-256 matches the pinned manifest hash
- [x] Independent whole-branch review and final scoped confirmation — approved, no blockers

## Compatibility and rollback

- Existing HTTP v1 routes, MCP v1 tool names/results, and accepted legacy SSE paths remain available.
- Tier-1 serverless search/extract/recover and diagnostics remain supported through explicit standalone boundaries.
- Direct Python imports of the former internal `argus.mcp.tools`, `argus.mcp.resources`, and `argus.mcp.local_adapter` execution modules move to explicit `argus.development_mcp_*` modules; MCP wire compatibility is unchanged.
- Revert the S9d commits to remove CLI negotiation, S9c commits to remove `*_v2` tools/descriptor, S9b commits to remove session/security machinery, and S9a commits to leave the resolver unused.
- No production activation, deployment, provider call, paid spend, secret change, database migration, or homelab mutation is included.

## Checklist

- [x] Code follows existing patterns
- [x] New features have tests
- [x] User-facing compatibility boundaries are documented above
- [x] Public wire compatibility is preserved; internal Python import movement is noted

## Evidence boundary

Base: `a4df7d25618674d976a29c3f0865c5f7bca5bf19`  
Head: `03e339c`  
The GitHub `production` environment was refreshed read-only before publication and still requires reviewer `Khamel83`; this PR does not request or authorize deployment approval.

title: Define no-spend provider readiness gates
body:
> *This was generated by AI during triage.*

## Summary

- replace the overloaded provider status concept with orthogonal configuration, reachability, compatibility, usability, cooldown, spend, and derived-health evidence
- define a complete fixture/mock/contract/live-probe matrix for all 14 providers
- keep `doctor`, `health`, default admin smoke, and `mcp check` provider-search-free
- require a separate named, bounded, idempotent, receipt-backed workflow for live validation
- split the provider catalog from executable registration; non-free providers require credentials, stable account binding, finite budget, and durable spend storage
- enforce `free_only` at both plan construction and final invocation so explicit selection, fallback, cache reuse, concurrency, and restart cannot reach a paid provider
- make provider-declared exhaustion durable and terminal until authoritative reconciliation, with no paid half-open health probe
- preserve simultaneous configuration failures, unknown/expired evidence, uncertain charges, and safe error categories visibly across HTTP, MCP, CLI, Python, logs, traces, and budget reporting

## Current evidence handled

- SearXNG search is excluded from routine health; only a declared local health/metadata endpoint may be refreshed without explicit canary authorization
- Yahoo HTTP 200 with unfamiliar markup is `parse_error`, never healthy empty
- historical Serper not-enough-credit and Parallel/Valyu insufficient-credit observations map to terminal exhaustion only when imported with timestamp, scope, account binding, and receipt
- SearchAPI missing key prevents registration and any call
- credential rotation can clear authentication rejection but never same-account exhaustion

## Safety

- no paid or live provider calls were made
- no credentials, balances, provider payloads, or production state were read or changed
- unkeyed credential hashes are forbidden; credential-version and account identities are separate
- merge and deployment remain human-gated
